The new evidence of a Tuesday departure (passport at carryon early Tuesday) suggests the resident may travel on different days but still frequently. The single-person hypothesis remains strongest.

The new evidence of a Tuesday departure (passport at carryon early morning, keys and neck_pillow at elsewhere) suggests a mid-week trip, which is less typical for leisure and more for business. The pattern of frequent travel (previous Friday departure, now Tuesday) is more consistent with business travel.
